relation_kinds.translation: proposed translation correspondence; not a certified dictionary sense

editorial_review.scope: All 34 verses reread in both pinned texts.
notes: Gen 25:6–8,17: age and kinship expressions retain repeated units and distinguish supplied pronouns.
Gen 25:18–20: geographical construction and cross-verse placement of Abraham fathering Isaac preserved.
Gen 25:22–23: the supplied French pregnancy predicate and comparative oracle are attached to the complete corresponding clauses.
Gen 25:27–34: hunting skill, eating game, red food and the sale/oath formulas are preserved as idiomatic groups where required.
editorial_review.limitations: Both passes performed by the same editor; no independent dictionary-sense verification; publication checks deferred.
